integrity: The limits are proved by explicit finite law, Stirling kernel asymptotics and controlled boundary masses. Exact finite enumeration independently checks the finite law; finite tests are not used as proofs of limits.
scientific_limitations: Sharp total-variation asymptotics only for last preference given full success under independent one-coin direction choices; no multiple-preference joint law or alternative parking rules. Previously published exact finite formula is acknowledged. Historical priority not definitively settled.
title: A sharp critical-window total-variation law for probabilistic parking preferences
